name: Atlantic Fence Company, LLC

reviewSamples.author: Photo of A. Weatherholt
reviewSamples.text: Atlantic Fence Company generously installed a new fence at our home as part of Military Makeover with Montel. We absolutely love the transformation and the difference it has made to our property. It's wonderful to see a local company willing to donate its time, materials, and expertise to support a veteran family.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of L R
reviewSamples.text: Great company! Great customer service! We recently had Atlantic Fence install a bronze aluminum fence for us in one area and a decorative white PVC picket fence for us in another area. Dave, Linda, Jorge and the whole crew did an excellent job. They were done in one day, no issues or delays.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Bryce Boynton
reviewSamples.text: Recently had Atlantic Fence install a horizontal wood fence around our complete back yard. Crew worked diligently and stayed late to finish in one day. They were able to accommodate a few minor changes on the fly and we are thrilled with the results.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kyle Pinon
reviewSamples.text: Dave and the crew did an amazing job for us! The area we wanted a fence was on a steep slope with curves. They did an incredible job of keeping it close to ground to secure animals, but it also looks way better than we thought possible.
